scripts.desktop:build: npm run engine:prepare && tauri build --features desktop --config src-tauri/tauri.engine.conf.json
scripts.test:rust: cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --example process_guard_fixture && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib --features desktop
scripts.desktop:build:mac: npm run engine:prepare && npm run decoder:prepare && tauri build --features desktop --config src-tauri/tauri.engine.conf.json --config src-tauri/tauri.decoder.conf.json
scripts.desktop:bundle:windows: npm run engine:prepare && tauri build --features desktop --config src-tauri/tauri.engine.conf.json --config src-tauri/tauri.decoder.conf.json
